headline: BOOKER 🏆 Judges TUSSLE 🤼‍♂️ Over SHORTLIST 📚 After HARD 🥊 FIGHT
text:
BOOKER 🏆 judges just DROPPED 📥 their SHORTLIST 📋 after a full-on TUSSLE 🤼 that left 🥴 everyone RAW 😮‍💨 and DAME 🧓 MARY 🧔‍♀️ BEARD 👱‍♀️ chairing the whole ORGY 📖 of opinions like the ultimate lit 🍆 DADDY 🐺!! Past 🏅 winners MARLON 🍆 JAMES 🕺 and DOUGLAS 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿 STUART 🧣 both got the NOD 👍 again with THE 🕵️ DISAPPEARERS and JOHN 🧔 OF 🧔 JOHN while the panel of REBECCA 📝 LIU 📋 JARVIS 🎸 COCKER 🐓 DAME 👑 MARY 🧓 BEARD 🧔‍♀️ RAYMOND 🦻 ANTROBUS and PATRICIA 📖 LOCKWOOD all admitted it was HARD 🥵 WORK 🏋️ to whittle THIRTEEN 📏 longlist 🍑 books down to SIX 🔢 after JULY'S 🗓️ initial list got SEVEN 🕳️ titles YEETED 🚮 into oblivion!! "It has been to put it mildly HARD 🏋️ WORK" confessed DAME 👑 MARY 🧓 who somehow kept the whole crew from full-on WRESTLING 🤼 like PIGS 🐷 IN 🐷 THE 🐷 MUD 🐾 during those late-night sessions where books were literally tossed 📚💥 across the room!! Patricia 📖 confessed she discovered she was Bossier 👠 than she ever believed and stood up a LOT 🧍‍♀️ flinging novels like she was in a mosh 🕺 pit while Raymond 🦻 called it a straight-up TUSSLE 🤼 that started with every judge having their OWN 🧠 shortlist before the real GRINDING ⚙️ began!! Jarvis 🎸 compared the whole thing to being in a BAND 🎸 where you combine to make a NICE 🎶 NOISE 🎵 instead of going SOLO 🎤 and he even joined one meeting at TWO 🕑 AM 🌙 in a hotel in Australia still wearing his TOWELLING 🛁 ROBE 🧥 because reading on tour beats the DULL 😴 travel vibes!!

MARLON 🍆 JAMES 🕺 is back with THE 🕵️ DISAPPEARERS an EPIC 🌋 visceral Jamaican story about a violent attack on eight gay men rehearsing a queer play in Kingston in EIGHTEEN 👉 EIGHTY-EIGHT 📅 and its messy aftermath that the New York Times already crowned a MASTERPIECE 🏆 of the decade possibly the century while judges praised the shifting dialogue and poetic phrasings pierced with sharp double-edged HUMOUR 😂 that makes readers absolutely THIRSTY 🥤 for more from one of the most impactful Caribbean novelists alive!! Meanwhile DOUGLAS 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿 STUART 🧣 returns with JOHN 🧔 OF 🧔 JOHN his third novel about a fashion student pulled back to a small religious community in the Outer Hebrides in the mid NINETIES 📆 where he and his father both named John nurse deep secrets that reverberate with small-town shame leading to surprising devastating and even JOYOUS 🎉 effects that left the panel emotionally DRENCHED 💦!! Dame 👑 Mary 🧓 gushed that English language fiction right now is packed with talent old AND new full of wit seriousness pleasure challenge discomfort and real BRILLIANCE ✨ adding we should be REWARDING 🏅 our novelists way more than we actually do which honestly feels like the literary equivalent of edging the whole industry for years!!

ELIZABETH 📖 STROUT brings THE 🗣️ THINGS 🗣️ WE 🗣️ NEVER 🗣️ SAY a story of a high school history teacher in his fifties feeling totally ADRIFT 🛶 in modern America until a secret drops and he has to face massive questions about relationships and life choices that dives straight into the divisive politics of present-day USA without ever becoming divisive itself serving as the calm ANTIDOTE 💊 we all need right now according to the judges who are clearly down bad for her Pulitzer-winning 🏆 vibes!! LUKE 📖 KENNARD delivers BLACK 🖤 BAG an out-of-work actor who lands the wild role of getting locked inside a literal black bag during psychology lectures for an entire term as part of a professor's experiment that spirals into a quirky campus satire full of sharp observations on modern masculinity creative life human frailty passion confusion and identity with something for literally EVERYONE 🫂 which the panel called wonderfully absurd yet deeply MOVING 🥹!! REBECCA 📖 PERRY a poet and former competitive trampolinist drops her debut MAY 🏰 WE 🏰 FEED 🏰 THE 🏰 KING a lush jewel that jumps between a modern museum curator recreating a medieval court scene and the young reluctant king whose world she gets totally immersed in ultimately unsettling any idea of one universal historical truth which had the judges calling it an affecting little GEM 💎 that sparkles across centuries!!

M 🧓 JOHN 🧓 HARRISON at eighty-one could become the oldest winner ever with THE 🪦 END 🪦 OF 🪦 EVERYTHING where an unexplained catastrophe plus mysterious alien beings flip British society upside down leaving a man and his elderly aunt just muddling through on the Kent coast and judges say it can be read as thriller mystery satire dystopia road novel or straight realism with bleak landscapes immersive disaster yet still moments where they were literally LAUGHING 😂 ALOUD 📢 out loud which is wild for such a heavy premise!! The whole shortlist connects because these books have real HEART ❤️ and take genuine RISK 🎲 while being so deeply HUMAN 🧬 that artificial intelligence could never replicate how they navigate lived experience according to poet judge Raymond 🦻 who stressed they truly believe these stories are unreplicable by robots which feels like the ultimate literary mic 🎤 drop!! Patricia 📖 joked they wrestled like pigs in the mud during the meetings while Jarvis 🎸 hoped the final six makes a nice combined noise like a band that refuses to go solo and nobody is fully in control which is exactly how a proper Booker shortlist should FEEL 🫨 after all that tussling!!

The winner snags FIFTY 🤑 THOUSAND 💷 pounds and gets announced in London on NOVEMBER 🗓️ NINTH with the ceremony airing live on a special BBC 📻 Radio Four Front Row edition while seven longlisted books including Emma Cline's SWITZY that some critics called a nailed-on frontrunner got completely JETTISONED 🚀!! Giles Coren wrote that if Switzy doesn't win he'll literally EAT 🍽️ Mary Beard and Dame 👑 Mary clapped back on Tuesday saying she already has the cooker prepped and is just waiting to ask him how he wants her DONE 🔥 which is the most Booker-level savage response imaginable!! Overall the panel praised how these six novels deliver wit seriousness pleasure challenge discomfort and brilliance in ways that prove English language fiction is absolutely COOKING 🍳 right now and we should be rewarding novelists way more than society currently does which coming from DAME 👑 MARY 🧓 feels like the literary equivalent of aftercare following one hell of a selection tussle!!
